name: Floatsy — Chat Button Widget
author: Berkay Yavuz

sections.description:
Floatsy adds a beautiful, fully customizable floating chat button to your WordPress website. Visitors reach you in one tap on the messaging apps they already use. No coding — everything is set up from a modern admin panel with a live preview.

🌍 11 admin panel languages: English, Türkçe, 中文, Español, العربية, हिन्दी, Português, Русский, 日本語, Deutsch, Français

Free features

Chat platforms
* WhatsApp — WhatsApp-style popup chat or direct link
* Telegram, Instagram, Facebook Messenger
* Click-to-call phone and click-to-email buttons
* Show up to 2 platforms at the same time — one main button fans out into both

WhatsApp popup chat
* Agent name, profile photo and status text
* Welcome message and pre-filled message
* Online / offline status from your business hours

Business hours
* Working days and hours in your site’s timezone (overnight shifts supported)
* Custom offline message

Design
* Circle and rounded-square shapes, solid and gradient styles
* Pulse animation, notification badge, tooltip
* Brand color per platform
* Live preview in the settings page

Visibility
* Show / hide on desktop and mobile — globally or per platform
* Hide on specific pages
* Display delay

Floatsy PRO

Upgrade from inside the plugin (Floatsy Chat → Upgrade) to unlock:

  • Unlimited platforms at the same time + 9 more: Viber, Signal, LINE, Discord, TikTok, X, Snapchat, SMS and any custom link
  • WhatsApp team — multiple agents with their own number, photo, role and working hours; visitors choose who to talk to
  • Click statistics — clicks per platform and per day, widget opens and click-through rate, stored in your own database
  • Greeting bubble — a friendly message pops up above the button after a few seconds
  • Smart triggers — show the widget after scrolling or on exit intent, auto-open the chat
  • Dynamic messages — {page_title}, {page_url}, {product_name}, {product_price} in pre-filled messages
  • All designs — 5 extra shapes incl. “Pill + text” button, 5 extra styles (outline, glass, 3D, neon, ring), 6 attention animations, 3 sizes, custom icon, custom CSS
  • Advanced display rules — logged-in users / guests, only on selected pages, hide on post types, hide on WooCommerce cart & checkout
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Floatsy”, or upload floatsy-chat-widget.zip
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Floatsy Chat in the left menu
  4. Enable the platforms you want and enter your details
  5. Click Save Settings — done!
sections.faq:
How do I set up WhatsApp?

Go to the Platforms tab, enable WhatsApp and enter your phone number with country code, digits only. Example: 905551234567 for Turkey, 15551234567 for USA.

How many platforms can I show?

The free version shows up to 2 platforms at the same time (sites that had more enabled before version 3.0 keep them). Floatsy PRO removes the limit and adds 9 more platforms.

What happens with multiple platforms?

A single main button appears. Clicking it fans out all platform buttons with a smooth animation — no clutter on your site.

How do business hours work?

Enable Business Hours, choose working days and hours. Hours use the timezone from Settings → General. Outside those hours, the WhatsApp popup shows your offline message.

Does it slow down my website?

No. One small CSS and one small JS file (no jQuery) load only on pages where the widget is shown.

Does Floatsy collect any data?

The plugin uses the Freemius SDK. On activation you can choose to opt in to share basic, non-sensitive site data (WordPress and PHP version, plugin version, site URL and admin email) with the developer to get security and feature updates — or skip it. Nothing is sent if you skip. See the Freemius privacy policy.

Click statistics in Floatsy PRO are stored only in your own database — no cookies and no personal data.

Can I change the admin panel language?

Yes. Open the Language tab and pick one of 11 languages, including right-to-left Arabic.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1

  • IMPROVED: After buying PRO, the settings page shows a one-click “Install PRO now” button instead of upgrade prompts

3.0.0

  • NEW: Floatsy PRO (unlimited platforms, 9 more platforms, WhatsApp team, click statistics, greeting bubble, triggers, dynamic messages, more designs, display rules)
  • NEW: Live preview in the Appearance tab
  • NEW: Button styles (solid, gradient) and animation picker
  • NEW: Profile photo for the WhatsApp popup
  • NEW: Settings page remembers the open tab after saving
  • IMPROVED: Redesigned buttons — smoother shadows, hover and open/close animation
  • IMPROVED: Keyboard support — Escape closes the widget, buttons are real buttons
  • IMPROVED: Admin panel no longer loads Google Fonts
  • FIX: Business hours now use the site timezone instead of UTC, and support overnight hours
  • FIX: The widget could be clicked while still hidden by the display delay
  • FIX: Platform hints showed raw keys instead of text
  • FIX: Chinese and Japanese admin translations were empty
  • CHANGE: The free version shows up to 2 platforms at once; existing sites keep the platforms they already had enabled
  • CHANGE: The optional Google Analytics usage ping from 2.1.0 was removed; opt-in usage data now goes through Freemius

2.1.0

  • NEW: Optional, opt-in anonymous usage statistics
  • IMPROVED: Missing translations now fall back to English

2.0.0

  • NEW: Multi-platform support — WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Facebook, Phone, Email
  • NEW: Smart fan-out animation when multiple platforms are active
  • NEW: Per-platform hide on mobile / hide on desktop controls
  • NEW: Per-platform custom colors and labels
  • IMPROVED: Admin panel redesigned with platform management cards
  • IMPROVED: 11 admin panel languages (added Turkish)

1.0.0

  • Initial release with WhatsApp floating button
